name: browser.action-gate
description: Before a commit verb (click, press Enter, upload, eval…) runs in a Vibium session: may it run now? Specialises JEV-works TOOL_GATE (41% fewer prompts over 1,013 real calls, 0 unsafe auto-approvals of 94) to one browser action over one page snapshot. Canonical copy: JEV-works kit/modules/contexts/browser.action-gate.json. Status: drafted, not yet measured on a browser corpus.

artifact.type: pending browser action over one page snapshot

modules.name: action-gate
modules.purpose: Route one commit action to auto / escalate / refuse from what the page and the target element say, before it runs.

mutatesWorld.instructions: Would this action change anything beyond the browser tab, such as submitting data, changing a record, sending a message, paying, or deleting?

criteria.true: The target submits, saves, sends, pays, deletes, or otherwise changes something the page describes as stored or sent.
criteria.false: It only navigates, opens, expands, filters, or reveals within the tab.

reversible.instructions: If this action turns out to be wrong, does the page offer a way to undo it without losing anything?

criteria.true: The page shows an undo, cancel, edit, or draft path, or the action only opens or navigates.
criteria.false: The page describes the action as final, or no undo path is visible.

spendsOrSends.instructions: Does this action spend money or send data to a party outside this page?

criteria.true: The target or the surrounding text is about paying, ordering, sending, sharing, or publishing.
criteria.false: Nothing is paid, sent, shared, or published.

blastRadius.instructions: How much is affected if this action does the wrong thing?
criteria: Only what is on screen in this tab.
One record or one form on this site.
A shared resource others depend on.
Money, a message that leaves, or data that cannot be pulled back.
blastRadius.note: Level indexing (0- or 1-based) is confirmed on the first live run before scoreAtLeast is trusted; until then the gate leans on the nouls.

compose.positive: the action may run now without a person

notForJev.judgement: Is this host on the allowlist?
notForJev.instead: Exact host match in code (Policy.allowHosts), before the snapshot is even taken.
resolveRef() against the current map in code; a stale ref throws and the caller re-maps.

notForJev.judgement: Is this a payment, send, or delete?
notForJev.instead: Policy.humanGate regex on the target label in code: C10 parks it for a person before any POST.

notForJev.judgement: Did the operator already approve this kind of action in this session?
Is the typed value safe to show the judge?
notForJev.instead: describeAction() redacts fill/type values and any password field in code; the judge never sees them.
